worked.problem: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in order. If ∠BAD = 43°, find its opposite angle ∠BCD.
actions: Locate ∠BAD = 43° at vertex A and ∠BCD at the opposite vertex C.
Because all four vertices lie on one circle, the two opposite angles are supplementary.
